exchangeability_limits.consequence: the exact two-sided sign-flip p at k = 4 is reported as a descriptive, assumption-dependent statistic with the exchangeability assumption labeled, never as assumption-free inference; the companion t interval carries distributional assumptions that are especially fragile at k = 4
exchangeability_limits.limit: the four legal forms are hash-distinct but template-identical: they share model, question, instructions, the disposition-0..7 options and state structure, differing only in state.clues (bit0, bit2). A template-level effect would shift all four forms together, so form-level sign flips are not guaranteed to be exchangeable
exchangeability_limits.more_forms_require_redesign: raising k means a prospective, versioned generator redesign with its own audit (a new protocol boundary), never extra seeds or reordered history; this task performs no redesign
exchangeability_limits.pooling_forbidden: forms are not pooled across families and duplicates are not split: a cross-family claim needs its own registered estimand and error contract, and legal:low cannot become confirmatory by pooling with another family
exchangeability_limits.seeds_do_not_fix_exchangeability: more seeds within a form improve emission, coverage, variability and guard estimates but change neither k nor exchangeability; independent cluster exchangeability under the null must be defended on template/dependence grounds, not on hash-distinctness
exchangeability_limits.structure: complete 2x2 factorial over (bit0, bit2) of the target; the four forms are the entire finite legal form space, not a sample from a larger prompt population
